trial_title: Rapid Non-invasive Detection of Aortic Stenosis
brief_summary: Avicena is developing new non-invasive methods (hardware and software) for diagnosis of a variety of heart conditions. This study is designed to compare data obtained using Avicena's device, the Vivio, to data obtained from transthoracic echocardiography (TTE) for the diagnosis of moderate-to-severe aortic stenosis. Aortic stenosis (AS) is a disease of the valve (aortic valve) that separates the left ventricle of the heart from the aorta. When AS is severe, the heart cannot pump adequate amounts

eligibility_table.clinical_question: Does the patient have a confirmed diagnosis of aortic stenosis based on echocardiographic measurements showing aortic valve area <1.0 cm²?

eligibility_table.criterion: Ability to understand and sign informed consent
eligibility_table.justification: The patient is male and likely has the capacity to understand and sign informed consent.

eligibility_table.criterion: Willingness to undergo study protocol (in Pasadena CA)
eligibility_table.justification: The patient has not indicated any unwillingness to participate in the study protocol.
The patient has a history of significant bilateral carotid artery disease, which affects the ability to provide informed consent.

eligibility_table.criterion: History of carotid sinus hypersensitivity (fainting in response to minimal touching or positioning of the neck)
eligibility_table.justification: The patient has significant bilateral carotid artery disease, which may lead to carotid sinus hypersensitivity.

eligibility_table.criterion: History of significant or symptomatic carotid artery disease, or carotid artery stenting or surgery
eligibility_table.justification: The patient has a history of significant carotid artery disease with 80% and 90% stenosis, which excludes them.

eligibility_table.criterion: History of aortic valve surgery or transcatheter aortic valve replacement
eligibility_table.justification: There is no mention of a history of aortic valve surgery or transcatheter aortic valve replacement.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Has the patient undergone aortic valve surgery or transcatheter aortic valve replacement at any time in their medical history?

eligibility_table.criterion: Absent carotid pulse on initial examination (inability to palpate the carotid pulse)
eligibility_table.justification: The patient's significant carotid artery disease raises concerns about the presence of a carotid pulse.

eligibility_table.criterion: Open skin lesions at the site of Vivio application/examination
eligibility_table.justification: There is no information provided about open skin lesions at the site of Vivio application.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Does the patient have any open skin lesions at the site of Vivio application/examination that are greater than 1 cm in diameter?

eligibility_table.criterion: Presence of a carotid bruit on examination
eligibility_table.justification: There is no information provided regarding the presence of a carotid bruit on examination.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Does the patient exhibit a carotid bruit upon physical examination?
